ops.title: Import child lane: VM-side memory-only `cookiesync import` (plan A, bus #265/#268)
ops.description: Root authorized plan A (bus #268, 2026-09-30): Mac-initiated scoped export (`cookiesync cookies --browser chrome --profile Default --format playwright|webstorage -- HOST…` under the Mac's own Touch ID) piped over the Mac's owned outbound SSH into a VM-side `cookiesync import --ttl` that holds the wire document in the resident helper's memory, bound explicitly to (browser, profile, named hosts, expiry). The VM's `cookies --format playwright|webstorage|header -- HOST…` and `bridge open --json` serve from the imported data only for requests inside that scope and before expiry, and only after the Linux requestor principal is derived (existing refusal rules unchanged). Branch `yasyf/cookiesync-import` off `yasyf/cookiesync-linux` @ 921e0d4, worktree ~/.claude/worktrees/cookiesync/cookiesync-import; the M7 merge candidate (PR #3) stays independent, parent/child restack later. Not in scope: forced-command RPC bridge, any VM authority on the Mac, key export, batch grants, writes into stores, apply/converge, Mac registry or route changes. Synthetic tests only; real browser seeding may create ordinary browser state. Root owns merge/tag: one coherent release after independent review.

ops.text: `cookiesync import --ttl <d> --browser chrome --profile Default -- HOST…` reads the Mac export on stdin and the daemon holds it in memory only (no file, no cache tier on disk); restart of the helper drops it

Imported data is bound to (browser, profile, exact host list, expiry); a request naming any host, browser or profile outside the import, or arriving after expiry, is refused with no partial stdout and non-zero exit; TTL semantics are documented in README
Requestor principal (req:/sid:) is derived and its refusal applied before any imported data is served, for cookies and bridge_open
Darwin behavior unchanged (build-tagged or platform-neutral additions only); no `--no-sandbox`, no key export, no new approval path
Child PR opened on yasyf/cookiesync with synthetic-only tests and green exact-head CI (macOS + Linux jobs + linux-smoke step for import); astra finder + security refuter passes applied
Bus contract posted with the child head; no merge, no tag
